title: Geologic map of Jezero crater and the Nili Planum region, Mars
encoding: Uint8 source unit + 1; zero unmapped; one value per mesh cell; row zero north
modelNote: Geologic boundaries are published interpretations. Speed, grip, slip and wheel sinking are illustrative simulation assumptions, not measurements from the map.

units.name: Jezero fan 2 unit
units.label: Delta layers
units.description: Layered fan deposits left by ancient rivers in Jezero crater.

units.name: Jezero fan 1 unit
units.label: Older delta layers
units.description: A lower, older fan deposit inside Jezero crater.

units.name: Jezero floor unit
units.label: Crater-floor rock
units.description: Crater-floor exposures with varied textures and patches of overlying material.

units.name: Lower etched unit
units.label: Lower etched rock
units.description: An eroded, olivine-bearing unit below the upper etched rocks.

units.name: Nili Planum 2 unit
units.label: Nili upper plains
units.description: Lobate-edged, boulder-shedding exposures that often cap older units.

units.name: Nili Planum 1 unit
units.label: Nili lower plains
units.description: Older plains with smooth, rugged and mound-forming textures.

units.name: Eolian bedform unit
units.label: Wind-blown sand
units.description: Wind-shaped ridges of loose sediment called eolian bedforms.

units.name: Smooth unit, undivided
units.label: Smooth surface cover
units.description: Smooth deposits in low areas and on slopes; their origin varies.

units.name: Upper etched unit
units.label: Upper etched rock
units.description: Eroded rocks with ridged, cratered and rugged surface textures.

units.name: Crater rim unit
units.label: Crater rim
units.description: Impact-related rocks forming crater rims and terraced walls.

units.name: Crater ejecta unit
units.label: Impact debris
units.description: Material thrown out around an impact crater.
